verdict.rationale: Solid's fine-grained reactivity reruns only dependent code. Built-in Context and Stores handle global state, TypeScript and Vite are supported, and components are plain functions you can organize freely. Speed claims are backed by benchmarks and the Asciinema rebuild, and one developer reports staying happily on Solid after over a year on a largish product. On the maintainability side, a detailed hands-on critique reports lacking docs, alpha-quality devtools, slow SolidStart routing and Suspense pitfalls, and others note ecosystem gaps in third-party integrations. Missing for 10: first-party guidance on structuring large codebases or scaling across teams, mature devtools, broader independent evidence from large multi-team projects, and resolution of the reported routing and Suspense performance issues.
